name: Siri AI
desc: Apple's rebuilt assistant with personal context and onscreen awareness.
desc_zh: 苹果重构的助手，由 Apple Intelligence 驱动，能理解个人上下文与屏幕内容。
solves: Siri used to need exact phrasing and forgot everything; Siri AI follows ordinary language and uses what it knows about you and your screen.
solves_zh: 旧 Siri 要说标准口令还记不住事；Siri AI 能听懂日常说法，并利用它对你的了解与屏幕内容。
best_for: You are reading an article and want the assistant to act on what is on screen without retyping anything.
best_for_zh: 正在读一篇文章，想让助手直接对屏幕上的内容做事，不想再打一遍时。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — Apple Newsroom archive; channel C Apple newsroom coverage of the WWDC26 keyn）。 Missing from the ledger: apple has Apple Intelligence and MLX but no Siri entry. Announced 2026-06-08 at WWDC26, released 2026-09-14 with the 2027 software releases, and expanded to French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese and Spanish on 2026-10-26. Delayed in the EU for iOS 27 and iPadOS 27 because of the DMA. Siri AI sits on top of Apple Intelligence rather than replacing it. 首次公开日期来源：https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2026/09/siri-ai-a-profoundly-more-capable-and-personal-assistant-is-here/
